# anthropic_rbac_roles (Data Source)

Lists the custom roles of a Claude Enterprise organization, with the permissions each role grants, through the Admin API.

Custom roles are read-only through the API: they are defined in claude.ai
organization settings or provisioned by Anthropic, and attached to RBAC groups
there. Each organization has its own role catalog. Reference a role by `id`,
since Anthropic may change the `display_name` of a role it provisions.

Reading this data source makes one request for the role list and one for each
role's permissions. It needs a key created in claude.ai > Organization
settings > API with the `read:members` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_rbac_roles" "all" {}

output "rbac_role_names" {
  value = { for role in data.anthropic_rbac_roles.all.rbac_roles : role.id => role.display_name }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source.
- `rbac_roles` (Attributes List) The organization's custom roles, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rbac_roles))

<a id="nestedatt--rbac_roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rbac_roles`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the role was created.
- `display_name` (String) Name of the RBAC role. For a role provisioned by Anthropic, this can differ from the label claude.ai shows, and Anthropic may change it.
- `id` (String) ID of the RBAC role.
- `permissions` (Attributes List) Permissions the role grants. The API omits rows for features not enabled for the organization. An `organization` permission with the action `capability_access_all` or `capability_access_all_ga` is a blanket grant of every product feature, or every generally available one, listed as that single row. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rbac_roles--permissions))
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the role was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--rbac_roles--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rbac_roles.permissions`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Action the permission grants on the resource, for example `chat`, `use`, `always_allow` or `grant`. The vocabulary depends on `resource.type`.
- `resource` (Attributes) What the permission applies to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rbac_roles--permissions--resource))

<a id="nestedatt--rbac_roles--permissions--resource"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rbac_roles.permissions.resource`

Read-Only:

- `connector_id` (String) ID of the connector. Null unless `type` is `connector_tool`, `connector_scope` or `connector`.
- `organization_id` (String) UUID of the organization. Null unless `type` is `organization`.
- `scope` (String) OAuth scope the role may receive for the connector, server-encoded when it contains characters outside `[a-zA-Z0-9_-]`. Null unless `type` is `connector_scope`.
- `tool_name` (String) Published name of the connector tool, server-encoded when it contains characters outside `[a-zA-Z0-9_-]`. Null unless `type` is `connector_tool`.
- `type` (String) Kind of resource: `organization`, `connector_tool`, `connector_scope`, `connector` or `all_connectors`.
